title: Judah Pleads for Benjamin
reflectionText: The cup was found in Benjamin's sack, and Judah did not argue. He offered himself in the boy's place — to stay as a slave so the youngest could go home, and his father would not go down to the grave in grief. He had become surety for the boy, and here he kept his word. No answer comes back. What is asked of someone who will stand in another's place?
